name: writing-guidelines
description: Rules that make written English clear, specific and scannable. Load this skill before you write or revise any prose for a human reader: commit messages, pull request text, issue bodies, READMEs, docs, guides, changelogs, comments and chat replies. Load it even when the user did not ask about writing, style or tone. Also load it when the user asks you to shorten, simplify, tighten, proofread or rewrite text.
